Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.intro: These terms of use govern the use of OpenConformis, provided by Neura Labs UG (haftungsbeschränkt). By registering, you accept them.

sections.heading: Description of service
sections.body: OpenConformis compares an uploaded PDF or DOCX policy against a versioned regulatory framework and produces a preliminary assessment grounded in evidence from the original document. The application does not replace legal or compliance advice and does not provide a binding regulatory determination.

sections.heading: Account and access
sections.body: Every analysis and chat step requires an existing account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and must report any suspected misuse without delay.

sections.heading: Bring your own AI key (BYOK)
sections.body: Every real analysis and chat call runs exclusively on your own API key with a provider of your choosing. There is no operator key and no free run. Unevaluated models are clearly flagged before you select them.

sections.heading: No automatic outcome
sections.body: The AI does not make the final determination. Every assessment requires human confirmation; a justified override remains possible at any time. Requirements found not applicable still require a reasoned explanation in the result and in the export.

sections.heading: Limits and warranty
sections.body: There is no guarantee of EU hosting or zero data retention at the AI provider you choose; that provider's own terms apply in addition. The evaluation service is intended only for test and non-confidential documents and does not constitute legal advice.

sections.heading: License and commercial use
sections.body: The application code is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, not an OSI open-source license. Original documentation and sample data are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial use requires a separate written license from Neura Labs UG (haftungsbeschränkt).

sections.heading: Availability and changes
sections.body: As an evaluation offering, the feature set may change; individual model routes may be locked if they are not technically functional. These terms may be updated as the product evolves; continued use after a change constitutes acceptance.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms go to info@conformisgrc.com.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This notice describes what data OpenConformis, operated by Neura Labs UG (haftungsbeschränkt), processes and for how long it is retained.

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body: Neura Labs UG (haftungsbeschränkt), reachable at info@conformisgrc.com.

sections.heading: Account data
sections.body: Email address, name and session data for sign-in and registration.

sections.heading: Policy content
sections.body: Uploaded original policies, the analysis text derived from them, assessments, evidence, and the organizational context you enter. Original documents are deleted no later than 24 hours after the analysis completes; orphaned anonymous uploads after 24 hours. Full parsed text and embeddings are deleted after 7 days without activity, and after 30 days at the latest.

sections.heading: Your own AI key
sections.body: Your key is stored encrypted and only for a short time, bound to your user, session, purpose and draft. It is deleted when the run ends, or after 24 hours at the latest, and never appears in URLs, browser storage, logs, audit metadata or workflow payloads.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: Analysis content is sent only to the AI provider and model you chose, using your own key. OpenConformis does not operate its own model and is provider-neutral; there is no guarantee of EU hosting or zero data retention at that provider — its own privacy policy applies in addition.

sections.heading: Infrastructure
sections.body: The application itself runs on Vercel in Frankfurt; database and authentication run on Neon, also in Frankfurt.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Results, evidence and the review trail stay tied to your account until you delete them or the account. Deleting an account ends access immediately; deletion of linked policy data completes within 24 hours.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Access, correction and deletion of your account data on request to info@conformisgrc.com.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: A technically necessary cookie is required for the session. There are no marketing or tracking cookies.
